rev2changes.text:
Rev 2 changes

1. Type: 15 px base, 16 px answers and composer, nothing below 13 px; greeting 38 px.
2. Idle content is centred vertically; the composer sits with it.
3. Narrow approval: while an approval is pending, the composer is replaced by a fixed decision bar above the bottom bar, so Send / Edit / Don't send are always visible; the card scrolls above it. "Reply in chat instead" brings the composer back.
4. Long body is clipped with "Show full message"; every recipient is listed; attachment and expiry shown.
5. Rail: tooltips on every icon plus a Show labels mode.
6. Brief expands into actionable items that disappear when handled (try Done / Dismiss).
7. Coding status chip on the home screen; opens the task workspace (P2).
8. Waiting shows the step Core reported ("Reading your calendar"), never a percentage.
9. Footer is "Local · qwen3:14b"; routing and privacy details open on click.
10. Presence mark and a warmer first line for identity.

judge.text:
What to judge: calm at idle · type hierarchy · approval card clarity (verb + object buttons) · dark/light parity · narrow width bottom bar.

Not represented: real model latency, real voice audio, real data. Every value on these boards is sample data; nothing ran.
